# Selecting Slim Roof Rack Lights

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Choose slim roof rack lights that fit within the closed Dephep rack and offer a wide lighting pattern. [t4]

## Procedure

1. Choose lights slim enough to fit inside the Dephep rack with the lightcage closed.
2. Select bulbs offering a wide lighting pattern to minimize angling needs.

_Procedure reported by [t4]._
